description: Monitor TikTok for posts that mention keywords, brand names, #hashtags or @handles. Choose strict mention evidence, date windows, multi-source coverage and optional only-new delta state.

datePosted.description: Only keep posts published in this window. The actor asks TikTok for the matching publish window, merges a bounded unfiltered pass for recall, and applies the exact cutoff.
datePosted.title: Posted within

keywords.description: Terms to monitor. One per line. Accepts plain keywords and phrases ('nike', 'nike shoes'), hashtags ('#JustDoIt') and handles ('@gymshark'). Multi-word caption matches require a contiguous phrase; direct @handles require a clickable tag.
keywords.title: Keywords, brands, hashtags or handles

matchMode.description: 'Real mentions' keeps posts with a contiguous caption phrase, a matching hashtag slug, a clickable @mention or an explicit sound match. For direct @handle inputs only the clickable tag (or sound) counts. 'Every search result' also keeps weak search hits, labelled searchResult.
matchMode.title: What counts as a mention

maxItems.description: Optional global cap across all keywords and sources.
maxItems.title: Max posts in total

maxResultsPerKeyword.description: Maximum rows kept for each keyword after all sources are merged (1-500). TikTok returns roughly 130-240 posts per source query; deep mode can find more across sources.
maxResultsPerKeyword.title: Max posts per keyword

minPlayCount.description: Drop posts with fewer plays/views. Leave empty for no minimum.
minPlayCount.title: Minimum views

monitorName.description: Name for this watchlist's saved state. Use a different name for a separate set of keywords.
monitorName.title: Monitor name

onlyNewMentions.description: Emit only posts not seen by this monitor in previous runs. The first run backfills; 'new' means new to this monitor, not new on TikTok.
onlyNewMentions.title: Only new mentions

postedAfter.description: Optional exact cut-off, e.g. 2026-10-01 or '3 days'. The tighter of this and 'Posted within' applies.
postedAfter.title: Posted on or after

searchCountry.description: 'Any country' uses the fastest free connection. A specific country pins the search to that market's results, which is slower but shows what people there see.
searchCountry.title: Search from country

searchDepth.description: 'Just this term' runs one search. 'Standard' adds the #hashtag and @handle for single-word terms. 'Deep' also reads photo/slideshow posts, related searches and case/spacing variants. A direct @handle stays tagged-only in mentionsOnly.
enumTitles: Deep: + photo posts, related searches, variants
searchDepth.title: How wide to search

sortBy.description: Order of the final rows. 'Newest first' is the monitor-friendly order; TikTok's own newest ordering is used where available, with a client-side fallback.
sortBy.title: Order

soundUrls.description: Optional TikTok sound URLs or IDs to read as explicit sources, e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/music/original-sound-123... . Sound evidence sets soundMatch; a sound-only row uses source=sound and keyword=sound:<musicId>.
soundUrls.title: Brand or campaign sounds

title: TikTok Keyword & Brand Mention Monitor Input
